entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The Nissan RD engine series is the diesel version of the Nissan RB engine, using a single overhead cam, six-cylinder layout. It was the successor to the Nissan LD and SD six-cylinder engines and was joined by the six-cylinder Nissan TD engine.
